#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Inspect unpacked quarterly report structure (styles + text outline)."""
import sys
from xml.dom import minidom

DOC = "unpacked/word/document.xml"

def main():
    dom = minidom.parse(DOC)
    body = dom.getElementsByTagName("w:body")[0]
    paras = body.getElementsByTagName("w:p")
    print(f"Total <w:p> paragraphs: {len(paras)}")
    print("=" * 80)
    for i, p in enumerate(paras):
        styles = p.getElementsByTagName("w:pStyle")
        style = styles[0].getAttribute("w:val") if styles else ""
        texts = [t.firstChild.nodeValue for t in p.getElementsByTagName("w:t") if t.firstChild]
        txt = "".join(texts)
        # also capture delText for deleted content
        dels = [t.firstChild.nodeValue for t in p.getElementsByTagName("w:delText") if t.firstChild]
        if dels:
            txt += " [DEL:" + "".join(dels) + "]"
        label = f"[{i}]"
        print(f"{label:>6} style={style:<14} | {txt[:120]}")
    # Show top-level children of body in order
    print("=" * 80)
    print("Body children in order:")
    for j, child in enumerate(body.childNodes):
        if child.nodeType == child.ELEMENT_NODE:
            tag = child.tagName
            extra = ""
            if tag == "w:p":
                styles = child.getElementsByTagName("w:pStyle")
                if styles:
                    extra = " style=" + styles[0].getAttribute("w:val")
            print(f"  [{j}] {tag}{extra}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
